findings.observation: No bend cue occurs over the full winding-road clip in the initial 110-degree assumed-optics run. Semantic MP4 intentionally has no bend geometry. This is a user-capability gap; uncalibrated out-of-domain footage cannot establish calibrated-model recall.
findings.status: At assumed 110 degrees: 0 road-valid frames and no bend cue. At assumed 70 degrees: 127/1199 road-valid frames and two bend cues. Neither setting is a measured calibration.
